rappel_detail.anchor: snow picket, buried deadman or V-thread you build (no fixed anchors)
rappel_detail.station: Above the bergschrund on the Dome Glacier, below the 8,560 ft notch.
rappel_detail.notes: The one rappel, on a single 60 m rope, past the bergschrund. Conditions-dependent: in a low-snow year or with a well-bridged schrund it may be downclimbed. Many parties also belay or fix a handline on the upper rock arete near the summit.

set.rappels: One rappel on a single 60 m rope past the bergschrund below the notch, from an anchor you build in snow or ice; conditions-dependent
